messages.title: Welcome to MTG Reforged
messages.body: News from the developer will show up here. Have fun!

messages.title: We reached 50 versions!
messages.body: With this one we have reached 50 versions, full of fixes, improvements and ffeatures for you to enjoy!

messages.title: New in v0.10.0
messages.body:
• Spells that target a card in a graveyard, exile or library now show those cards in a carousel to choose from.
• Collection: keep several printings of the same card (and foil copies) as separate entries; search "All cards" to add any printing.
• Foil cards get keldon-market's holo shine.
• Undo: up to 20 steps, no more endless waiting when used during the opponent's turn (tap again to call it off).
• New app icon.
• Version numbers now go up with every app update; engine-only updates add a letter (0.10.0a).

messages.title: New in v0.58.0
messages.body: • The version number now counts our releases: this is the 58th, so v0.58.0 (the 105th will be v1.05.0). Updates that only bring a newer Forge rules engine keep the number and add a letter: v0.58.0a.

messages.title: New in v0.59.0
messages.body:
• Undo works with a spell on the stack: the spell goes back to your hand.
• Undo while choosing attackers or targets backs out and undoes, instead of loading forever.
• Undo is available from the start of a game, including resumed games.

messages.title: New in v0.60.0
messages.body:
• Undo with spells on the stack now uses the rules engine's own undo, which puts the stack back exactly: undoing a spell no longer re-casts other spells, loses triggered abilities or hands priority to the opponent.
• End Turn keeps ending the turn instead of turning into Undo.

messages.title: New in v0.61.0
messages.body:
• Undo in a resumed game with your spell on the stack puts the spell back in your hand. Games saved from now on also untap the lands that paid for it; in games saved before, those lands stay tapped.
• The undo button no longer lights up when there is nothing to undo yet.

messages.title: New in v0.62.0
messages.body:
• Undo rebuilt from scratch: every time the game waits for your play it saves the whole game (stack included), and undo steps back one prompt at a time, up to 20 times.
• Undo while paying a cost, choosing targets or attacking cancels that play and goes back to before it, instead of loading forever.
• A resumed game starts its history when it opens; undo there can still take back a spell you left on the stack.

messages.title: New in v0.63.0
messages.body: • Resuming a saved game no longer asks again the choices permanents made when they entered (like Sower of Discord's two players): they come back as they were. Applies to games saved from this version on.

messages.title: New in v0.64.0
messages.body: • Saved games keep your last 20 steps: after resuming, undo can go back to before the save. Applies to games saved from this version on.

messages.title: New in v0.65.0
messages.body:
• Resuming a game no longer shows the choices permanents make as they enter (like Sower of Discord's two players): the board is rebuilt quietly and the saved choices are put back. Games saved before v0.64 come back with those choices made by default.
• In a game saved before v0.64, tapping the greyed-out undo explains why there are no steps from before the save.

messages.title: New in v0.66.0
messages.body:
• Rebuilding a resumed board answers optional questions with no, so it can't take a card from your hand.
• The last resumed save is kept as a copy, to look into resume problems.

messages.title: New in v0.67.0
messages.body: • Saved games can be repaired from a computer (support tool).

messages.title: MTG Reforged for Windows
messages.body:
• MTG Reforged now runs on Windows 10 and 11: the same game, screens and decks, with its own installer that keeps itself up to date.
• On a PC: Esc goes back, right-click shows a card, drag with the mouse to flip through cards, F11 for full screen.

messages.title: New in v0.69.0
messages.body: • Faster start: loading the cards takes about 40% less time (from about 7.5 to 4.3 seconds on a fast PC; more on tablets).

messages.title: New in v0.70.0
messages.body: • Much faster start: the app opens with your decks and collection ready, and the rest of the cards finish loading in the background (a small Loading all cards sign shows on the home screen meanwhile). On a fast PC the home screen now appears in about 2.4 seconds instead of 8.7.

messages.title: New in v0.71.0
messages.body: • A Support the developer button on the home screen, with how to help keep MTG Reforged growing.

messages.title: New in v0.72.0
messages.body: • Windows: installing an update from the app now opens the installer. If your copy still closes without installing, install this version once from the website; later updates will work from the app.

messages.title: New in v0.73.0
messages.body: • Windows: Google Drive backup and restore now work.

messages.title: New in v0.74.0
messages.body:
• Backup and restore show a clear green banner when they work (and a red one when they don't).
• Windows: after updating from the app, MTG Reforged opens again by itself when the installer finishes.

messages.title: New in v0.75.0
messages.body: • Windows: Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms the card grids in decks and the collection, like pinch to zoom on Android.

messages.title: New in v0.76.0
messages.body: • Creatures that must attack (goaded, or that attack each combat if able) are marked as attackers for you, and if an attack isn't allowed the message says which creature has to attack and why. Goaded creatures glow red.

messages.title: New in v0.77.0
messages.body: • Floating mana shows each colour's mana symbol, bigger, with the amount underneath (x3).

messages.title: New in v0.78.0
messages.body: • Cards in choice dialogs (ordering cards, picking cards, targets) show big while you press and hold them, or right-click them on Windows.
